# Official Summarizer reference

Generated by `tool/generate_summarizer_reference.py` with the unmodified, pinned
MediaPipe 1.0.0 macOS arm64 wheel (the engine mediapipe_core bundles on
macOS, pinned as `MACOS` in its `tool/official_wheels.py`) and the version-1
Summarization 200M model, CPU. 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 generate different text; the
ctypes ABI is the same.
The script verifies both SHA-256 hashes before inference. It records completed
text, streaming chunks/terminal flags and Python ctypes layouts for both TLDR
and key-points modes. Inputs are original synthetic examples, including Unicode,
empty input and a smaller token budget. Tests compare the full resulting text;
the wrapper adds no prompts, truncation, formatting or postprocessing.

The model is a separate verified download: `dart tool/download_summarizer.dart`.
Tests live under `example_embedding/test` to select the modern runtime without
loading the incompatible inherited text runtime.
